metadata.title: 中华人民共和国药品管理法实施条例 (Regulations for the Implementation of the Drug Administration Law, State Council Decree No. 828)
metadata.edition: State Council Decree No. 828, signed 16 Jan 2026, published 27 Jan 2026, in force 15 May 2026 (Art. 89) · Arts. 24, 28, 60 and 89
metadata.legal_basis: Implementing Regulations of the Drug Administration Law (Decree No. 828) · Arts. 24, 28, 60 as in force; the official text governs.
metadata.applicability: Applicants, sponsors and market authorization holders reporting ICSRs (see the PV Info ICSR rulebook for scope).

metadata_verification: Source-register metadata; dates and legal status require human verification.
limitations: English rule-based extraction; no GPT or paid API.
